security.description: PrivateChat is designed to limit the exposure of your data, protect your accounts, and give you control over your conversations.

accounts.title: Protected accounts
accounts.description: Email address verification and authentication safeguards help limit unauthorized access.

data.title: Data minimization
data.description: Limit the information collected, avoid commercial exploitation, and delete data that is no longer necessary.

messages.title: Messages under your control
messages.description: The project plans to delete messages when they are read or after a duration chosen by the user.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: Protect sensitive data using appropriate encryption mechanisms according to its nature and intended use.

security.note: Security does not rely on a single feature, but on several layers of protection.
security.footer: PrivateChat — Your data is not a commodity.
